title: Austin Convention Center: Sales & Fiscal Health
summary:
*   Austin's Convention Center Subcommittee held a special meeting dedicated to the facility's performance.
*   Councilmembers received a detailed sales update, reviewing the Convention Center's revenue generation.
*   A comprehensive financial overview was presented, highlighting the facility's current fiscal health.
*   Discussions on these critical updates continued even after a formal quorum of the Council was lost.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - December 04, 1991 CONVENTION CENTER SUBCOMMITTEE
PALMER AUDITORIUM - ROOM 301
Councilmember Garcia called to order the special called meeting of the Convention Center
Subcommittee, noting that Councilmembers Reynolds, Larson and Nofzlger were in attendance.
The meeting included a Sales Update given by Raylene Brookshire and a Financial Update
presented by Betty Dunkerley, Sam Driggs and Larr Anderson.
Copies of overheads used for illustrations for both reports are on file in the City
Clerk's office.
The quorum of the Council was lost at 3iOO P.M. Discussion continued to 3:15 P.M.
